title: Agents
summary: Give AI agents the context and tools required to collaborate on software work.

sections.heading: Define a clear role
body: Describe the goal, the available tools, and the expected output before an agent begins work.

sections.heading: Supply useful context
body: Connect the agent to the relevant project files and constraints rather than relying on an isolated prompt.

examples.code:
Goal: document a release
Context: docs/en, release notes
Output: reviewed Markdown

sections.heading: Review outputs
body: Treat agent output as part of a normal engineering workflow: inspect, test, and approve changes.
